source: OpenAlex API /works (IDs written from the response by scripts/run_search.py)
query: WhatsApp AND (misinformation OR rumours OR rumors OR lynching)
filter: title_and_abstract.search.exact:WhatsApp AND (misinformation OR rumours OR rumors OR lynching),is_retracted:false,publication_year:2022-2026
oql:
get works where retracted is (false)
  and year >= (2022)
  and year <= (2026)
  and title-abstract has ("WhatsApp" AND ("lynching" OR "misinformation" OR "rumors" OR "rumours"))
